deadline.value: Best consideration: November 30 (international) or December 15 (domestic); December 1 for automatic fellowship nomination; late applications until April 14 with much less funding. Years inferred.
deadline.quote: For best consideration, apply by November 30 (international) or December 15 (domestic).

gre_subject.value: Optional; may be a plus-factor for some research areas after blind initial review
gre_subject.quote: General and physics subject GRE scores are optional, with no negative impact on applicants who choose not to submit them.

supervisor.value: Not required for admission, but applicants are advised to contact faculty about research alignment before applying; no reply does not count against you.
supervisor.quote: We advise applicants to contact individual faculty members to explore research alignment before applying.

funding.value: TA/RA appointments include a monthly stipend and full tuition and general-fee waiver; RA stipend equals TA stipend
funding.quote: These appointments include a monthly stipend and a full waiver of tuition and general fees.

entry_route.value: A master's is not required; four-year degree with a 3.0 GPA
entry_route.quote: A master's degree is not required for consideration into the PhD program.

app_fee.quote: The application fee for the Physics PhD program $60 for U.S. citizens and $70 for international students.

fee_waiver.value: Extremely limited; same criteria for international and domestic; based on alignment with the department's mission; none for late submissions
fee_waiver.quote: Due to the high volume of requests, fee waivers are extremely limited and are granted only to applicants who demonstrate a strong alignment with the Department of Physics' strategic mission. The criteria and standards for fee waivers are the same for both international and domestic applicants.

gre_general.value: Optional; holistic review is blind to whether scores were sent; may be a plus-factor
gre_general.quote: General and physics subject GRE scores are optional, with no negative impact on applicants who choose not to submit them.

notes: International applicants need a four-year degree (Higher National Diplomas excluded).
